title: Mannatech Announces Promotion of Peter Griscom to Chief Operating Officer
summary: Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX ) announces the promotion of Peter Griscom to Chief Operating Officer of Mannatech Incorporated (the "Company") effective July 1, 2025. Peter Griscom brings more than 10 years of experience in the direct selling channel and has extensive experience in working in the consumer goods space, including launching, leading, and restructuring companies while creating efficiencies in manufacturing, sales, and marketing. Prior to his promotion, Mr. Griscom served as the Company’s senior vice president of global operations since August 21, 2024 and prior to that served as the senior vice president of product, innovation, supply chain from July 3, 2023 through August 20, 2024. He holds a B.S. from the University of Auburn and an M.S. from the University of Utah.
